summary: First-finish smoke test for FH UNRI Lab Booking. Backend + frontend both broadly working. All critical flows verified: auth, rooms, public settings, booking creation with CAPTCHA/NIM/operating hours validation, overlap detection (inside/partial/wrap/exact non-overlap), status check, PATCH restriction after approval, cancel, approve, reject, race-condition approve guard (409), reschedule (with room_id required), user CRUD, kiosk token regen+verify, Excel+PDF exports, WebSocket connect, mahasiswa cache. Frontend booking form (/pesan) submitted successfully producing LAB-2026-0006; /cek-status shows booking with cancel button; /masuk admin login redirects to /dasbor/admin; Admin Kiosk tab regenerates token and shows URL; /kiosk/tv?token=<valid> loads dark monthly calendar with LIVE indicator.
passed: Validation: invalid CAPTCHA 400, invalid NIM 400, start>=end 400, outside op-hours 400
Overlap 409 with conflicts+suggestions for inside (09-10) and partial (10-12) overlap
POST /api/bookings/{id}/approve -> 200; second overlap approve -> 409 (race guard OK)
GET /api/reports/export.xlsx (5117 bytes) & export.pdf (2196 bytes) as admin
Rate limiting effective (429 hit during test volume)
Frontend: landing -> /pesan -> submit with CAPTCHA -> success LAB-2026-0006
Frontend: /cek-status search by code shows booking + Cancel button
Frontend: Admin Kiosk tab regenerates token & shows kiosk URL
Frontend: /kiosk/tv?token=valid shows dark monthly calendar with LIVE indicator
notes: Kiosk regen response field is `kiosk_token` (not `token`) — frontend already uses correct field.
Reschedule endpoint requires `room_id` in body (in addition to date/start/end/reason); worked when included.
WebSocket booking_created event not directly captured due to rate-limit blocking secondary create attempts during WS test; connection itself verified.
